name: edf-bridge
description: edf-bridge (bridgeMaker) — adds cross-standard mapping edges of one provenance tier to a working graph. One app, three registry-dispatched modes: -specified (deterministic cedsId anchor pass -> SPECIFIED_MAPPING, confidence 1.0, no matchPredicate), -derived (STUB, no-op per DECISIONS §18), -implied (findMappedItem; Stage-1 embedding retrieve adapted from trackA, Stage-2 rerank/calibrate [PINNED-DEFERRED]). Generic: reads each standard's mappingInstruction from its DmeStandardRoot; no per-standard code. Graph access resolved by name via instance-lifecycle; idempotent MERGE; unresolved endpoints -> orphan report.
author: tqii
